label: Joint-satisfiability model of the LORD_3 Dei Filius root route
paraphrase: On the unified Dei Filius route's root model (four roles; source the selected root, recipient a second intellectual being), given excluded middle: the unified root bundle holds, the restricted willing premise and 'Whatever is LORD_3 is LORD_1' hold with a permissive willing relation, recipient is an intellectual being other than source, and the selected root has every Dei Filius attribute. Hence every premise of the LORD_3 root route holds together in this interpretation. The willing relation is permissive, so the model does not discriminate recipient-directed from other willing. A statement about this interpretation only.
